optAlertMe.message: Alert me when usage crosses a threshold

optShowBar.message: Show a usage bar above the chat box

optBarHint.message: Off by default. Turning it on adds the scripting permission (Chrome already grants claude.ai through the usage endpoints). The bar extracts only the usage figures Claude attaches to each reply; it never stores or sends your messages. On the Free plan this is the only place your limits appear.

optHistoryHint.message: Usage, paid spend and prepaid balance are recorded locally on every successful refresh, roughly once every 10 minutes. The history is stored only in this browser. In the export, a missing value stays empty: it means the data was unavailable, not zero.

optReviewText.message: A short review is the main way other Claude users find this extension. It takes a minute.

optProText.message: Your Claude limits on your phone, and a Slack or Discord ping before you hit them. Optional and paid; this extension stays free.

optWinText.message: UsagePeek shows your usage next to the clock with the browser closed, and reopens your Claude Code projects the moment a limit resets.
